title: galliaria prostrata
intro: Galliaria prostrata, commonly known as Alpine sea lavender or Rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Galliaria prostrata include its ability to act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular choice for topical applications. The bioactive constituents of Galliaria prostrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
